title: The Hateful Memes Challenge: Detecting Hate Speech in Multimodal Memes
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the ability of multimodal models to detect hate speech in memes, where religion is one of several protected categories. The analysis specifically tracks the prevalence of hate directed at religious groups.
findings: The dataset analysis revealed that religion is a prevalent target for hate speech, being the second most common protected category (after race/ethnicity) attacked in the development set, present in 39.3% of hateful examples. Unimodal (text-only) hate speech was found to frequently target religious groups, with the word 'muslims' appearing as a frequent term.
